expectations.text: 明确判定 Frame size: 250 A（修正空格后）在 IEC 60947-2:2024（Cl. 3.1.1）中合法有效，不应改为 Inm，并说明 Inm 属 GB/T 14048.2 国内约定符号（IEC 60947-2 中未出现）
expectations.evidence: L11-21: rejects colleague proposal and validates "Frame size: 250 A" under IEC 60947-2:2024, noting Inm is a domestic Chinese symbol absent from IEC 60947-2 (note: omits exact Cl. 3.1.1 and GB/T 14048.2 citation, guessing "沿袭 2016 版 2.18 条").

expectations.text: 指出 Mechanical durability / Electrical durability 中的 durability 不属于 IEC 60947-2:2024 术语（0 次出现），应改为 operational performance / operating cycles（Cl. 8.2.4.2 & Table 7）或 endurance（Annex M / R）
expectations.evidence: L38 explicitly permits keeping "durability" ("部分样本亦写作 durability，须全册统一" / "若样本体系已固定用 durability，至少须将 times 改为 operating cycles"), failing to identify that durability has 0 occurrences in IEC 60947-2:2024 or cite Cl. 8.2.4.2 / Table 7 operational performance.

expectations.text: 指出 times 为直译错误，应改为 operating cycles / operations / cycles
expectations.evidence: L38: "times 系'次'的直译，不用于 IEC 开关设备寿命参数... 计量单位为 operating cycles".

expectations.text: 指出 IEC 语境下美式拼写 Molded Case Circuit Breaker 与无连字符 circuit breaker 不合规，应改为英式连字符 moulded-case circuit-breaker 与 circuit-breaker（美式仅限北美 UL 489 语境）
expectations.evidence: L47, L66, L75: flags US "Molded" and unhyphenated "circuit breaker" -> "Moulded-Case Circuit-Breaker" and "circuit-breaker".

expectations.text: 指出 Icu 单位仅写 kA 缺少有效值限定，应写为 kA rms（并注明交流电压类型或频率）
expectations.evidence: L46 & L70 revise Icu to "36 kA at 415 V" with zero mention of "rms" / "kA rms" anywhere in the report.

expectations.text: 指出 100% Icu 缺少范围限定/试验电压核对（及 of Icu 规范写法），需按对应型号数据表核实
expectations.evidence: L46 allows "100 % of Icu（或 100 % Icu）" and Section 5 never flags "100% Icu" as an unscoped claim requiring model/voltage-scope datasheet verification.

expectations.text: 指出数值与单位之间缺半角空格（250A / 800V / 8kV / 36kA / 415V）
expectations.evidence: L48: flags missing spaces in "250A, 800V, 8kV, 36kA, 415V, 100%" -> "250 A、800 V、8 kV、36 kA、415 V、100 %".

expectations.text: 明确声明初稿中所有数值未经产品数据表核实，不代填、不背书
expectations.evidence: L5 & L62 only say not to fill in missing parameters; never explicitly declares that all existing numerical values in the draft are unverified against a product datasheet.

expectations.text: 指出缺失必备字段（如 Ue / In / Icm / Icw / tsd / 选择性类别 A 或 B / 脱扣器类型中的至少两项）
expectations.evidence: L83-96: flags missing In, Ue/AC/frequency/poles, tr/tsd, Icw, Icm, isolation suitability, pollution degree (note: L89 erroneously calls Cat A/B "Utilization category A / B").
